notes: Prices are the published 1 July 2026 quarterly schedule unless a different effective_date is stated on the road (WestConnex: 1 January 2026, its own annual cycle).

Authoritative per-trip pricing is the TfNSW Toll Calculator API v2. This file is the fallback / cross-check / offline table.
Records with confidence != "verified" MUST be confirmed before production use.

toll_roads.name: WestConnex M4-M8 Link
toll_roads.description: CORRECTED AGAIN in the 2026-09-09 cross-check pass, resolving the 'needs_verification' interpretation call the 2026-09-07 pass explicitly flagged (see the superseded description this replaces, kept in git history): this is NOT a flat toll, it is the same flagfall+per-km formula as M4/M8/M5E. Evidence: the official CartoDB toll-calculator source (the same api_key-embedded endpoint backing the TfNSW Sydney Motorways Toll Calculator, `toll_pricing.json` row ref=28) prices 'M4-M8 Link' with `toll_type="Distance"`, fee_light=0.6667, fee_heavy=2.0001, flagfall_light=1.80, flagfall_heavy=5.41, light_capped_fee=12.74 (the WestConnex NETWORK cap, not a distinct per-road one) — the exact same formula inputs as M4/M8/M5E. Directly confirmed by Linkt's own published `wcx_pricing_2026.json` origin-destination trip table: the SAME link at two different real trip lengths prices differently in a way a flat $6.48 toll cannot -- 'Haberfield - Rozelle' (length_m4m8=4.43km) costs light_cost_m4m8=$4.75, while 'Haberfield - St Peters' (length_m4m8=7.02km, the link's full length) costs light_cost_m4m8=$6.48. Both figures are exact hits on flagfall($1.80)+rate($0.6667/km)*distance: 1.80+0.6667*4.43=4.75; 1.80+0.6667*7.02=6.48. A flat toll would charge $6.48 for BOTH trips; it does not. The old flat-$6.48 model happened to read correctly only for a trip that traverses this link's FULL length end to end (Haberfield to St Peters) and silently overcharged every shorter partial trip through it. Modelled as distance_with_flagfall like M4/M8/M5E, with this road's own per-road cap set to Linkt's own full-length 'M4-M8 Link (Haberfield to St Peters)' price ($6.48/$19.45) -- the same 'road cap = Linkt's own full-segment price' convention M4 (cap=10.79), M8 (cap=9.15) and M5E (cap=9.15) already use -- on top of the shared $12.74/$38.22 WestConnex network cap.
toll_roads.verify_note: APPEND-ONLY correction: this is a NEW revision (effective_date bumped to the date this cross-check corrected the charging MODEL, 2026-09-09), superseding rather than overwriting the 2026-01-01 'needs_verification' flat-priced revision, per app.models.toll.TollRoadPriceRevision's append-only contract -- that revision had real, chargeable price fields (not a not_captured placeholder), so this is a genuine model correction, not merely completing a blank record. See description for the two independent sources (toll_pricing.json ref 28, and wcx_pricing_2026.json's own OD trip table) that corroborate the formula over the flat interpretation.
